title: George Grenville, by William Hoare
description: Three-quarter-length seated portrait of George Grenville in a powdered wig and dark gold-embroidered robes, holding a folded paper, before a green curtain.

provenance.credit: William Hoare, George Grenville (1764), public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

focus.name: paper
focus.note: the folded paper in his hand: useful for 'the bill' / taxes

accuracy: Painted during his ministry (1763-1765), so it shows him as the audience should picture him in 1763-65.
